detail.title: Synthesis of Autonomous Problem Prioritization Frameworks
detail.summary: Continued research into the mapping between predictive alert escalation in network telemetry and intrinsic motivation frameworks for scientific discovery. The current synthesis focuses on defining formal operational metrics for novelty and significance in autonomous agents.

children.title: formal metrics for assessing scientific problem novelty and impact in curiosity-driven discovery agents

detail.reason: Refining the synthesis between operational alert escalation (telemetry) and intrinsic motivation (curiosity-driven learning) to improve problem prioritization metrics.
